args.message:
Bump fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity, unbounded
recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Upgrade within the 2.x
line to the fixed version 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Security
- Fixes **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
- Affected versions: `<2.9.4` — 2.8.0 was vulnerable.
- 2.9.4 is the fixed release on the current 2.x line.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.
